heading_en: Gross JTD Risk Positions of Securitization Products (CTP)
summary_ja: 証券化商品(CTP)のグロスJTDリスク・ポジションとネットJTDリスク・ポジションの算出、特定順位参照型クレジット・デリバティブの扱い、相殺できる場合とできない場合を定める。
summary_en: Provides for the gross and net JTD risk positions of securitization products (CTP), the treatment of nth-to-default credit derivatives, and the cases in which offsetting is and is not permitted.
paragraphs: The provisions of Article 268 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the gross JTD risk positions of products falling under securitization exposures, etc. among securitization products (CTP). In this case, the term "securitization products (non-CTP)" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "securitization products (CTP)."
The gross JTD risk position of a position in a product included in securitization products (CTP) that does not fall under securitization exposures, etc. shall be the market value of that product.

An nth-to-default credit derivative shall be treated as a tranched securitization product having the attachment point and detachment point calculated by the following formulas. Attachment point = (N − 1) ÷ total number of names; Detachment point = N ÷ total number of names. N is the number corresponding to the rank specified in advance; the total number of names is the total number of names in the pool of underlying assets.

The provisions of paragraph (3) of the preceding Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the net JTD risk positions of securitization products (CTP). In this case, the term "securitization products (non-CTP)" in that paragraph shall be deemed to be replaced with "securitization products (CTP)."

In calculating the net JTD risk positions of securitization products (CTP), the offsetting prescribed in each of the following items may be made according to the case set forth in that item: (i) Where the long position and short position of an index-referencing securitization product have the same type and series of the referenced index and the same tranche held: offsetting between the long position and short position of the securitization exposures, etc. (including offsetting where maturities differ); (ii) Where an index-referencing securitization product is decomposed into exposures to individual obligors and all of the following requirements are satisfied: offsetting between the long position and short position of the same individual obligor: (a) Where decomposition is made using a valuation model, the gross JTD risk position of a single obligor that is a constituent name of the securitization product shall be the difference between the value of the securitization product assuming a recovery of zero upon default of that single obligor and the value of the securitization product using the recovery rate in accordance with market practice; (b) In decomposing into JTD risk positions of individual obligors, the effect of default of the individual obligors of the securitization product shall be taken into account, and the total of the JTD risk positions relating to the decomposed individual obligors shall be consistent with the JTD risk position of the securitization product before decomposition; (c) Decomposition shall be limited to vanilla securitization products (meaning securitization products other than exotic securitization products); (iii) Where the type and series of the index are the same for the long position and short position of tranched index-referencing products and of non-tranched securitization exposures, etc.: offsetting by decomposing and replicating (meaning reproducing the securitization exposures, etc. before decomposition so as to satisfy the requirements set forth in item (ii)(b)) the long position and short position of those securitization exposures, etc.; (iv) Where, with respect to the long position and short position of index-referencing products, the exposure of a non-tranched index-referencing product of one position can be replicated by a combination of exposures of securitization products of multiple tranches of the other position: offsetting between the position of the securitization product after that replication and the position of that index-referencing product; (v) In the case of a combination of a long position and short position by an index-referencing product and by constituent names that are single obligors included in the index-referencing product: offsetting between the long position and short position corresponding to a single constituent name obtained by decomposing the index-referencing product.

The following offsetting shall not be made: (i) Offsetting between different tranches of the same index and the same series; (ii) Offsetting between positions of different series of the same index; (iii) Offsetting between positions of different index families.
